compatibilityPolicy: Nebula's tested dependency matrix is used for the browser asset-path integration. Automatic updates stop at a new major version.
regressionFixes: Disabled wisp-js 0.4.1 per-host stream limiter because it iterates connection.streams as an array and crashes Node.
Changed the default transport from Libcurl.js to Epoxy TLS; Libcurl.js remains selectable.
Corrected the wisp-js updater URL from the nonexistent main branch to master.
